transcript.statement: Trustworthiness is paramount in the RollCall system to protect sensitive student attendance data. My requirements ensure data is encrypted (TRU-01), access is controlled (TRU-02), and all modifications are logged (TRU-03) for accountability. Students must authenticate to view their records (TRU-04), and data integrity must be verified (TRU-05). Additionally, mechanisms for reporting breaches (TRU-06) and enforcing session timeouts (TRU-07) are essential for maintaining security and privacy.

transcript.statement: Ethical and compliance considerations are vital for the RollCall system to ensure it operates within legal frameworks and maintains accountability. requirements.text: The system shall ensure secure authentication of users to prevent unauthorized access to attendance data.
The system shall provide real-time data synchronization using energy-efficient methods to maintain accurate attendance records across multiple classes.
The system shall implement a logging mechanism that prioritizes critical security and safety events while allowing less critical logs to be processed asynchronously.
The system shall maintain historical attendance data for a minimum of five academic years to support long-term analysis and comply with regulations.
The system shall allow students to view their attendance records with a response time of under 3 seconds.
The system shall generate attendance reports within 5 seconds for up to 1000 students while ensuring data integrity.
The system shall implement energy-efficient algorithms for data processing and reporting to minimize energy consumption.
The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations such as GDPR when handling student attendance data.
The system shall provide transparency in attendance recording by logging all attendance changes with timestamps and user identification.
The system shall allow students to dispute attendance records through a formal process within 10 days of marking.
The system shall notify students of their attendance status via email or app notification within 24 hours of a class.
The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict attendance data access to authorized personnel only.
The system shall undergo regular security audits to identify and mitigate potential vulnerabilities.
